note: METHOD (first tail slice with the new triage; about 50 tool calls, 4 WebSearch and 1 WebFetch). Two background scripts, MusicBrainz (artist match on name and dates, then works with recording-rels) and Deezer (album search on the name; track searches on surname + viols/fantasia/consort/in nomine/pavan ...), then Apple (iTunes Search, entity=song&attribute=composerTerm, 45 composers) and album lookups to confirm. WHERE THE BRIEF FAILED: (1) English viol music sits on mixed discs whose track titles carry no composer (Phantasm: Mico as 'Four-Part Consorts: Set 2: Fancy No. 14'; Fretwork In Nomine II: Baldwin as 'Proportions to the Minim'). The brief's Deezer album search and MusicBrainz work browse miss most of it; Apple's composerTerm song search found Mico (Concerto di Viole's near-complete disc and Phantasm's), Baldwin, Parsley, Blankes, W. White and Tregian. The brief should name composerTerm, and 'none found' stays weak for English viol composers. (2) Deezer carries synthesised 'Tempus Electronic Ensemble' albums (2024: Bassano, Blankes, Brewer, East, Hingeston, Jeffreys, Ravenscroft) and Phillip W. Serna's self-released Midwest415 albums (IMSLP notes his recordings on the pages). I ignored the first (computer renderings) and kept works resting only on Serna with confidence 'low' (Blankes Fantasias a 3, Rusca's two canzoni, Bevin In Nomines 1-2, Woodson, Daman: 7 entries); drop them if self-released discs do not meet the floor. (3) Recordings on recorders or brass do not count: Bassano Nos. 2-4, Pattrick, Leetherland, Cavaccio, Strogers's consort song. (4) Matches I could not confirm were skipped, not guessed: Hingeston (CPO 2026 'Fantasy-Suites', Echo du Danube: no VdGS numbers), Christopher Gibbons's F-major suite (AAM) and the other suites, A. Gabrieli's Ricercar 6 (Centaur 2016 may play it as 'del nono tono'), Borchgrevinck's Paduana (BIS). SCOPE CALLS: Cesare's La Ioannina is kept as two violins and continuo (the print says 'Due cornetti ò violini'; the recording is by cornett and sackbut players). Christopher Gibbons VdGS 19-30 are '2 trebles, bass, organ' on IMSLP (the census dropped the organ; all skipped anyway). Haussmann's Fuga prima and secunda are entered as a standard quartet as the Armida play them (IMSLP: 'violin, 2 violas, cello'). ADDED FROM DISCS I OPENED: Strogers's In Nomines Nos. 3 (a 5) and 4 (a 6) (Savall, Alia Vox 1998; no IMSLP page under his name in the census or among its out-of-scope pages) and Haussmann's Fuga secunda (IMSLP page outside the census). Serna is the sole performer credited on his Bandcamp album (opened). Rosseter's 1609 Lessons duplicate Morley's (m01). Meyer, Raverii, Ballard, Folop and Dufay's Vox page are editors, printers or transcriptions, not the composers of those pages. OOS PAGES WORTH A SECOND LOOK: Tallis '2 In Nomines' (No. 2 is recorded on viols by Phantasm, Fretwork, Charivari Agréable), Bevin 'Browning' a 3 (Concentus Musicus, Rose Consort, Serna), Du Caurroy Fantasie 1-2 (Savall), R. White 'Fantasias 1-6' (recorders). WEAK 'none found' (common names): Johnson, White, Holmes, Guy, Farmer, Cato, East, Bull, Gibbons, Milton, Mundy, Simpson, Webster, Baldwin. The census labels Birtwhistle 'early-music'. Levels follow the other viol-consort slices (2-4); minutes come from the recordings. BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 8 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Blankes: Fantasias a 3 ("A Phancy of Blankes"); Daman: Ut re mi fa sol la a 3; Rusca: Canzon prima a 4 in F major ("La Borromea"); Rusca: Canzon seconda a 4 in G major; White: Fantasia a 6 No. 2; Bevin: In Nomine a 5 No. 1; Bevin: In Nomine a 5 No. 2; Woodson: Vt re mee fa a 3.
